transcript.content:
<issue>
[Feature]: Anthropic disable_parallel_tool_use 配置缺失
框架有 parallelToolCalls 通用字段但未映射 Anthropic tool choice。

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the Anthropic model implementation (grep -ril anthropic, look for tool_choice / ToolChoice / toolChoice handling) and the generic parallelToolCalls field (GenerateOptions or similar). Report file paths and the code (with line numbers) where Anthropic tool choice is built from options, and how parallelToolCalls is defined.

content.content: {"summary":"Anthropic tool choice is built in AnthropicToolsHelper from GenerateOptions.getToolChoice(). The Anthropic module never reads parallelToolCalls, so disable_parallel_tool_use is not set. parallelToolCalls is a plain Boolean field on the generic GenerateOptions.","findings":["Anthropic file: agentscope-extensions/agentscope-extensions-model/agentscope-extensions-model-anthropic/src/main/java/io/agentscope/extensions/model/anthropic/formatter/AnthropicToolsHelper.java","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:60-70 loops over the ToolSchema list and adds each as a Tool via builder.addTool.","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:72-75: `if (options != null && options.getToolChoice() != null) { applyToolChoice(builder, options.getToolChoice()); }`","AnthropicToolsHelper.java:93-111 is private static applyToolChoice(MessageCreateParams.Builder, ToolChoice). It maps ToolChoice.Auto to ofAuto(ToolChoiceAuto.builder().build()) at line 96.","ToolChoice.None maps to ofNone(ToolChoiceNone) at line 98.","ToolChoice.Required maps to ofAny(ToolChoiceAny) at lines 99-105, with a log.warn that Anthropic has no direct 'required'.","ToolChoice.Specific maps to ofTool(ToolChoiceTool.builder().name(specific.toolName()).build()) at line 107.","Any other type only logs a warning at line 109.","The ToolChoiceAuto/Any/Tool builders are called without .disableParallelToolUse(...). The only 'parallel' hits in the Anthropic module are in AnthropicMessageConverter.java (lines 87, 146, 202, 209), which handle message conversion, not options.","Generic ToolChoice type: io.agentscope.core.model.ToolChoice, imported at AnthropicToolsHelper.java:32.","parallelToolCalls definition is in agentscope-core/src/main/java/io/agentscope/core/model/GenerateOptions.java.","GenerateOptions.java:54: `private final Boolean parallelToolCalls;`","GenerateOptions.java:84: the constructor assigns `this.parallelToolCalls = builder.parallelToolCalls;`","GenerateOptions.java:335-337: `public Boolean getParallelToolCalls()` returns the field. Its javadoc says it may be null if not set.","GenerateOptions.java:483-486: the merge method uses the primary value if non-null, otherwise the fallback's.","GenerateOptions.java:540: `private Boolean parallelToolCalls;` in Builder.","GenerateOptions.java:800-803: `public Builder parallelToolCalls(Boolean parallelToolCalls)` sets the field and returns this.","GenerateOptions.java:748: Builder.toolChoice(ToolChoice)."],"confidence":0.9}

input.instruction: Look at agentscope-core/src/main/java/io/agentscope/core/model/ToolChoice.java and tell me how to instantiate ToolChoice.Auto (constructor or INSTANCE?).

content.content: {"summary":"ToolChoice.Auto is a public no-arg record, so you instantiate it with the constructor. The file has no INSTANCE singleton.","findings":["ToolChoice.java:52 declares `record Auto() implements ToolChoice {}`. It has no fields and no INSTANCE constant.","The Javadoc usage example at ToolChoice.java:39 uses `.toolChoice(new ToolChoice.Auto())`.","None and Required are also no-arg records, so they are instantiated the same way. Specific takes a tool name, as in `new ToolChoice.Specific(\"name\")`."],"confidence":0.97}
